set.body:
Scheduling lane: maintenance. Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19: A single unreproduced compile failure is a watch item, not an inferred race or automatic release block. On recurrence retain the full log and exact tree.

Historical finding and scope retained below; current acceptance ownership above governs.

During intake-contract mutation testing (2026-09-17), a full-tree `sbt test` reported that `corpusNative / Compile / compileIncremental` failed. An immediate re-run of the same tree exited 0 with zero [error] lines, as did the scoped gate. It followed several `corpusJVM/clean corpusIntake/clean` runs, so a parallel compile race after cleans is the likely cause. That is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis: the error text was lost to a `tail` truncation.

Watch item. If it recurs, capture the FULL log before re-running. Relates to bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX (no CI: every gate result is self-reported); a CI run is where a flaky compile would become visible.
set.title: [maintenance] Watch: corpusNative compileIncremental failed once after module cleans and did not reproduce
